races.name: Radnor Hills Water Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: First Candidate
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with highest rating but faces tactical disadvantage against uncontested leader, 36 days since last run may need this
runners_data.comment: Entitled to win at Haydock last time and entitled to win this, even with a penalty
runners_data.spotlight: Irish point winner who built on her early hurdling promise with a comfortable defeat of a subsequent winner at Haydock (1m7f, good; 1-4); she was entitled to win that and she's entitled to win this, even with a penalty.

runners_data.name: Enya
runners_data.note: Only pace-setter gets ideal tactical setup but moderate ability may not withstand late challenges, good recent form
runners_data.comment: Second on hurdling debut in November; respectable since then in bumpers
runners_data.spotlight: Chased home a good horse (who won easily) in a 3yo hurdle at Warwick in November and subsequent efforts, all respectable, have been in good-ground bumpers; tongue-tie added for this return to hurdling and there's probably more to come from her.

runners_data.name: Peace Of Amaron
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with 144-day absence creates major fitness concerns despite trainer having only one runner
runners_data.comment: Questionable what she achieved on debut and was tailed off here next time
runners_data.spotlight: Not beaten far when fifth of six in a juvenile hurdle on debut but they went steady and she was tailed off here the next time at 66-1; opposable.

runners_data.name: Silvereen
runners_data.note: Previously ran well over course and distance, hold-up style suits but needs significant improvement to win
runners_data.comment: Probably in need of further as she was keeping on when a 5l third over C&D in March
runners_data.spotlight: She's probably in need of further as she was keeping on when a 5l third over C&D in March (good); still appeals as one of the better alternatives to First Candidate.

runners_data.name: Briery Rose
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse carrying penalty weight with modest recent form, likely needs more time to develop
runners_data.comment: Early indications are that she'll need more time before fulfilling what potential she has
runners_data.spotlight: Well related, being from a family that has served the Daly yard well; however, early indications are that she'll need more time before fulfilling what potential she has.

runners_data.name: Bits Ballou
runners_data.note: Lowest-rated hold-up horse already well beaten by Silvereen here in March, hard to recommend
runners_data.comment: Well behind Silvereen here in March and she fared no better at Newton Abbot when 50-1
runners_data.spotlight: Well behind Silvereen here in March and she fared no better at Newton Abbot when 50-1; couldn't recommend.

runners_data.name: Dame In Disguise
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with very modest form, now tries cheekpieces but held by several of these previously
runners_data.comment: Very modest form in bumpers and over hurdles, and she's held by Silvereen
runners_data.spotlight: Very modest form in bumpers and over hurdles, and she's held by Silvereen; now goes in cheekpieces.

races.paceDynamic: Enya is the only confirmed front runner in this small field and should get an uncontested lead through reasonable fractions. With most rivals adopting hold-up tactics (First Candidate, Silvereen, Peace Of Amaron, Briery Rose, Bits Ballou, Dame In Disguise), the pace will be sustainable rather than punishing. The lack of pace pressure means Enya can dictate terms while the hold-up horses will need to time their challenges from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and hold-up horses with a strong finish, as there will be plenty of horse left for a sustained drive from the back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Enya gets easy fractions and stays on strongly up the hill
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows her to save energy for a sustained kick, while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on the testing Ludlow finish. Her prominent style perfectly suits the race dynamic with no pace competition.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Quality Prevails Late
scenarios.trigger: If First Candidate's class advantage tells in the final furlong despite the tactical setup
scenarios.body: Her superior rating and recent Haydock win demonstrate she has the quality to overcome any pace bias, with Harry Skelton timing the challenge perfectly. The hill plays to her stamina strengths over the lesser-rated opposition.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Silvereen Steps Forward
scenarios.trigger: If the longer trip brings out improvement in Silvereen who was keeping on well over course and distance
scenarios.body: Her March third here suggests the track suits, and the sustainable pace will allow her to build momentum through the final stages. The hold-up style works if she can find extra improvement at this longer trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Shock
scenarios.trigger: If Enya stops quickly and allows a rank outsider to benefit from the chaotic finish
scenarios.body: The easy lead might leave her vulnerable to stopping, creating opportunities for horses like Peace Of Amaron to pick up the pieces. A complete pace collapse would turn the race into a lottery for the outsiders.

watchPoints.text: Enya could get very soft fractions with no pace pressure and prove hard to pass up Ludlow's testing hill
First Candidate returning after 36-day break may need the run despite being highest-rated horse in field
Peace Of Amaron has been off for 144 days which creates major fitness doubts for hold-up horse
Silvereen ran well over course and distance in March and could benefit from longer trip if stepping forward
The small field and lack of pace pressure means any horse stopping quickly could cause dramatic position changes

races.name: Lion Leintwardine Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Briery Butterfly
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 39-day break with consistent 3m form but concerning fall last time out at this distance
runners_data.comment: Maiden who was on the retreat when departing two out at Southwell (3m)
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden who has had a few chances now in handicaps and she was on the retreat when departing two out at Southwell (3m, good), where Shorten Sassy ran third; not wildly appealing at the minute.

runners_data.name: Shorten Sassy
runners_data.note: Front-runner dropping in grade off reduced mark with solid 3m form and 3lb claimer taking useful weight off
runners_data.comment: Off a reduced mark she finally showed more when a 3l third over 3m at Southwell last month
runners_data.spotlight: Off a reduced mark she finally showed more when a 3l third over 3m at Southwell last month (good) and she would appear to have found her level; respected.

runners_data.name: Churchman
runners_data.note: Habitual front-runner now 0-20 over hurdles but has been competitive in similar handicaps on good ground recently
runners_data.comment: Last race didn't go to plan; respected on previous seconds over 2m3f and 2m6f
runners_data.spotlight: Now 0-20 over hurdles but was bang there in 2m3f/2m6f handicaps (good) in March and when beaten nearly 20l the last time he got pressured up front; unlikely to be far away.

runners_data.name: Athena's Dream
runners_data.note: Prominent 4-year-old with stamina concerns at 3m and 5lb out of handicap proper carrying bottom weight
runners_data.comment: Has failed to raise her profile in two handicaps; stamina concerns over this far
runners_data.spotlight: Has failed to raise her profile in two handicaps (blinkered; 2m4f/2m3f) and there are stamina concerns over this longer trip; 5lb out of the weights.

runners_data.name: Edna E Mode
runners_data.note: Course winner at this distance last April returning to form with solid third at Exeter over 2m5f on good ground
runners_data.comment: Couple of good runs over 2m5f (including latest) and perhaps needs this longer trip
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up over 2m5f here last April and returned to that sort of form when third over that trip at Exeter (good); she was beaten nearly 7l and is off the same mark here, but perhaps this longer trip is what she needs.

runners_data.name: Slack Alice
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare with visor back on, appreciated return to good ground 18 days ago but needs significant improvement
runners_data.comment: Third here 18 days ago; needs a bit more off the same mark but hard to dismiss
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden under both codes; seemed to appreciate the return to good ground here 18 days ago (2m5f) and having the visor back on was no bad thing; needs a bit more off the same mark but hard to dismiss.

runners_data.name: Son Of Tyran
runners_data.note: Back-marker with fading tendencies who showed best form on good ground but has been well beaten in handicaps
runners_data.comment: Back on good ground and raised to 3m, he should be capable of better
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten 24l and about 20l in his two handicaps but both were over 2m on good to soft, and this Irish point runner-up ran his best race under rules in a good-ground bumper; back on this surface and raised to 3m, he could be capable of a lot better; the market should be enlightening.

runners_data.name: Joker Jack
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with no current form claims and 6lb out of the weights making task virtually impossible
runners_data.comment: Has no form claims and being 6lb out of the weights is no help; instantly opposed
runners_data.spotlight: Has no form claims and being 6lb out of the weights is no help; instantly opposed.

races.paceDynamic: Briery Butterfly leads with Shorten Sassy, Churchman, Athena's Dream, Edna E Mode and Joker Jack all holding prominent positions, creating a crowded front group over this stamina-sapping 3m trip. The pace will be steady early but the presence of multiple front-runners means sustained pressure from halfway as they jostle for position. Slack Alice and Son Of Tyran are the only hold-up horses but both have stamina questions at this distance. This pace setup strongly favours prominent racers who can secure good early positions without getting drawn into a speed duel.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Pairs Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the front group splits into two distinct pairings turning for home
scenarios.body: Briery Butterfly and Shorten Sassy emerge as the main protagonists with their superior stamina reserves, while the other prominent horses fade from their exertions. Both have shown form over this trip and can sustain their effort to the line.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Suits
scenarios.trigger: If the large front group maintains cohesion until the final half-mile
scenarios.body: The relentless gallop finds out the stamina limitations of several runners, allowing Edna E Mode's proven 3m form to shine through. Her previous course form at this distance gives her the edge over rivals trying the trip for the first time.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely searching and the front group comes back
scenarios.body: Slack Alice benefits from her patient tactics as Sean Bowen times his challenge perfectly, with the mare's recent good ground form proving decisive. Son Of Tyran also emerges late but his finishing limitations prevent him from winning.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the crowded front group goes too fast early and several drop out quickly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair where any of the survivors can win, with Athena's Dream's 4-year-old improvement curve potentially decisive. However, her stamina concerns at 3m remain a significant obstacle to overcome.

watchPoints.text: Briery Butterfly may not handle the early crowding given her fall last time when retreating at this course and distance
Athena's Dream could struggle for stamina as she steps up to 3m for the first time with previous efforts suggesting 2m4f is her limit
Son Of Tyran typically fades in the final furlong so any early prominence would be a major concern for connections
Churchman's front-running tactics could dictate the early pace given his habit of making the running in similar contests
Slack Alice needs Sean Bowen to find cover early as her hold-up style relies on others setting up the race

races.name: Radnor Hills Splash Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Hall Lane
runners_data.note: Prominent racer showing clear improvement for new Fergal O'Brien yard with two recent seconds, suited by good ground
runners_data.comment: Only 1-13 over fences but is threatening to double his tally; possibilities
runners_data.spotlight: Only 1-13 over fences but is threatening to double his tally, having stayed on for second in the last two of three starts for new yard, latest at Taunton (2m7f, good); possibilities off same mark.

runners_data.name: Law Of Supply
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse slipped to attractive mark after seven defeats, needs strong pace to set up finishing kick
runners_data.comment: On an attractive mark and has a good chance provided he can build on latest effort
runners_data.spotlight: Record of 0-7 since the double that initiated his chase career; however, has slipped to an attractive mark and holds a good chance provided he can build on latest effort, namely second at Wincanton (3m1f, good).

runners_data.name: Redbridge Rambler
runners_data.note: Versatile prominent runner with excellent course record fresh from yesterday's run, claiming jockey takes 5lbs
runners_data.comment: Two good runs over 3m1f in late 2025; inadequate trip latest; solid chance
runners_data.spotlight: Two good runs behind subsequent winners at Hereford and Catterick (both 3m1f, good) in late 2025; always struggling over an inadequate 1m7f at Wincanton (no headgear; cheekpieces return) in April and perhaps fortunate to get dropped 2lb; fair chance of another win.

runners_data.name: Nazare
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose recent chase form disappoints after promising hurdles double, 47 days since last run
runners_data.comment: Not in same form in two completed starts since hurdles double; switches to fences
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper winner who completed a 2m4f double over hurdles in November for a good start to his handicap career; not in same form in two completed starts since; chance of revival largely hinges on the switch to fences.

runners_data.name: Sunset Boulevard
runners_data.note: Likely pace-setter returning from 72-day break after wind surgery, key tactical advantage if unopposed early
runners_data.comment: Lightly raced 6yo who could prove resurgent on handicap/chase debut
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced 6yo; scored over 2m6f on hurdles debut and final start for Willie Mullins; had wind surgery since the latest of two dismal efforts for new stable; could prove resurgent on handicap/chase debut.

runners_data.name: Zacony Rebel
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up horse with strong Ludlow record (2-4), 33-1 winner here last time but follow-up uncertain
runners_data.comment: No certainty to follow up his C&D win, having been inconsistent for a while
runners_data.spotlight: Veteran who bounced back with 33-1 success from well out of the weights over C&D (good) most recently, taking Ludlow record to 2-4; just no certainty to follow up, having been inconsistent for a while.

races.paceDynamic: Sunset Boulevard appears the only committed front runner with Hall Lane and Redbridge Rambler likely to sit prominently, creating a potentially uncontested lead for the Venetia Williams runner. The hold-up horses Law Of Supply, Nazare and Zacony Rebel will need the pace to be strong enough to set up their finishing kicks over this staying trip. With limited early pace pressure, this looks set to become a tactical affair that may not fully test the stamina reserves. This race shape strongly favours the early pace-setters and prominent racers who can dictate terms without being hustled along.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Sunset Boulevard gets an uncontested lead and maintains a steady gallop.
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced 6yo can utilise his stamina and tactical advantage to resist late challengers who face too much to do. His wind surgery suggests connections expect improvement from his dismal recent efforts for the new stable.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Hall Lane and Redbridge Rambler track Sunset Boulevard closely and challenge turning in.
scenarios.body: These two in-form prominent racers can exploit any weakness in the leader while having enough in reserve to hold off the hold-up horses. Both have shown recent improvement and suit the likely steady pace scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong and the race develops into a true test of stamina.
scenarios.body: Law Of Supply's attractive handicap mark and Zacony Rebel's course form could pay dividends if the leaders go too fast early. The veteran Zacony Rebel particularly thrives at this venue with a 2-4 record.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Improving Nazare Surprises
scenarios.trigger: If the James Owen runner has improved significantly from his disappointing recent chase form.
scenarios.body: The 6yo bumper winner showed real promise when completing a hurdles double in November. His hold-up style could be effective if connections have solved his recent problems.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Sunset Boulevard gets pulled up again - two consecutive DNFs suggest serious issues despite wind surgery
Monitor how Redbridge Rambler handles running 24 hours after his Wincanton effort yesterday
Check if Nazare shows any early pace interest - complete change of tactics could signal renewed confidence
Observe Law Of Supply's jumping early - needs clean round to utilise his finishing kick from attractive mark
Watch for any market moves on Hall Lane who looks the most consistent recent performer

races.name: Welsh Guards Association Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Hooper
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with tactical advantage in a race lacking pace, though 498 days off and five-year losing run are major concerns
runners_data.comment: Fairly useful for Nicky Henderson until form went awry; absent since December 2024
runners_data.spotlight: Fairly useful for Nicky Henderson until form went awry; hasn't raced since December 2024 and was sold for £3,500 last May; on a five-year losing spell; best watched unless the market speaks positively.

runners_data.name: Pergamon
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who needs strong pace to be effective, recent winner but faces tactical disadvantage here

runners_data.name: Zucayan
runners_data.note: Another hold-up performer with strong course record but may struggle with the likely modest early gallop
runners_data.comment: Strong C&D record includes wins in this race in 2023 and 2025 (faller in 2024)
runners_data.spotlight: Suited by good ground; proved resurgent when last seen five months ago, enhancing a strong C&D record that also features wins (off 2lb lower) in this race in 2023 and 2025 (faller in 2024); very solid claims kept to this scenario.

runners_data.name: Soleil d'Arizona
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits good ground but Harry Skelton must overcome the pace bias to deliver her undoubted class
runners_data.comment: Skelton mare who is interesting off a workable mark back down in class
runners_data.spotlight: Skelton mare who had excuses (faced stiff task, bled from nose) in notable handicap returned to favoured good ground last time; quite progressive last spring to autumn and looks interesting off a workable mark back down in class.

runners_data.name: Ufouria
runners_data.note: Inconsistent hold-up horse carrying just 155lbs, significant weight advantage but poor recent hurdling form
runners_data.comment: Not particularly solid but her mark is attractive judged on peak efforts
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper winner in Ireland; inconsistent results for current stable, taking hurdles record to 0-8; not particularly solid but her reduced mark is attractive judged on peak efforts.

runners_data.name: Lord Cauvelliere
runners_data.note: Bumper winner stepping back up after poor autumn hurdles form, lightest weight at 151lbs could be crucial
runners_data.comment: Handicap debutant who is interesting on the form of his bumper win last May
runners_data.spotlight: Good-ground bumper scorer last May, comfortably beating a rival who currently has a mark of 115; failed to transfer the form to hurdles in the autumn but may improve now handicapping off just 93; interesting.

runners_data.name: The Tide Turns
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with dismal recent form and tendency to fade, can be dismissed unless market speaks
runners_data.comment: Dismal form for current yard; best watched
runners_data.spotlight: Gained sole hurdles success over four years ago when trained in Ireland; has dismal form for current yard and can be dismissed unless the betting suggests a resurgence is likely.

races.paceDynamic: Hooper appears the only natural front-runner in this small field, likely to set his own tempo from the start with five hold-up horses giving him an easy lead. With no genuine pace pressure early, Hooper can dictate a steady gallop that may not suit the collection of hold-up performers who need a strong pace to aim at. The race shape strongly favours Hooper's prominent position, as the hold-up brigade led by Pergamon, Zucayan, and Soleil d'Arizona will face the difficult task of making up ground against a horse who has controlled the tempo throughout.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hooper Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Hooper maintains his early advantage and the pace stays modest
scenarios.body: The front-runner faces minimal pressure early and can kick clear when the hold-up horses are still gathering momentum. Pergamon and Soleil d'Arizona emerge best of the chasers but struggle to close the gap in time.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses time their challenges perfectly despite the tactical disadvantage
scenarios.body: Pergamon and Zucayan produce strong late runs to overhaul Hooper in the final furlong. The class horses find enough despite the unfavourable pace scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Skelton Mare Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Soleil d'Arizona can overcome the pace bias with superior acceleration
scenarios.body: The Dan Skelton-trained mare uses her class to power through the field late despite the modest gallop. Her good ground form and Skelton's 8/26 strike rate provide the edge needed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If Lord Cauvelliere or Ufouria benefit from the light weights and pace collapse
scenarios.body: One of the lesser-rated horses takes advantage when the favourites fail to overcome the tactical setup. The 12lb weight advantage for Ufouria or Lord Cauvelliere's bumper form translates to hurdles success.

watchPoints.text: Hooper's fitness after 498 days off the track - any early signs of rustiness could change the race dynamic completely
The early pace development - if any of the supposed hold-up horses go forward early, it transforms the tactical picture
Pergamon's jumping rhythm in the back straight - his hold-up style needs fluent hurdling to mount an effective challenge
Soleil d'Arizona's position turning for home - Harry Skelton must have her close enough to strike despite the pace bias
The weights telling in the final furlong - Ufouria and Lord Cauvelliere carry significantly less than the main contenders

races.name: GC Rickards Mares' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Regal Renaissance
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits if pace is strong enough, but 43 days off and needs career-best from this position
runners_data.comment: Clear second at Stratford last time and appears capable of going one better
runners_data.spotlight: Posted best effort of her 2025-26 campaign when neck second, clear of the remainder, at Stratford (2m3f, good) last time; appears capable of going one better, having recorded sole chase success (November 2024) off current mark.

runners_data.name: Northern Air
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner making stable debut for new yard, 5lb claimer reduces burden but needs significant improvement
runners_data.comment: Ran encouragingly last time on stable debut and switch back to hurdles
runners_data.spotlight: Regressed in three chase attempts during a brief spell with Dan Skelton; ran encouragingly at Newton Abbot (2m1f, good; 1l second) last time on stable debut and switch back to hurdles; fighting chance off same mark, provided she's as effective returned to fences.

runners_data.name: Northern Symphonie
runners_data.note: Prominent style ideally suited to weak pace, first-time cheekpieces and fence debut could spark revival
runners_data.comment: Back on last winning hurdles mark; wears new headgear on chase debut
runners_data.spotlight: Hurdles form has dipped sharply for new yard but has she possibilities provided the combination of first-time cheekpieces, switch to fences and a physical tweak (wind surgery since last run) prompts a revival; back on last winning mark.

runners_data.name: Claim Du Brizais
runners_data.note: Hold-up type from in-form Skelton stable, Harry Skelton booking suggests confidence despite mixed chase form
runners_data.comment: Mixed results over fences but is still quite unexposed over this distance
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper/hurdles winner who has posted mixed results since switched to chasing, best effort when third at Warwick (2m4f, good) on penultimate start; mistake contributed to her defeat there latest; still quite unexposed over this distance and not written off.

runners_data.name: Ezmerellda
runners_data.note: Prominent runner badly out of form, nearly stone out of handicap but light weight could help if rediscovering ability
runners_data.comment: Unconvincing form for current yard; well out of the weights
runners_data.spotlight: Hurdles winner in 2023 for previous yard; form for current stable is far from convincing, most recently well beaten on chase debut; nearly a stone out of the weights back up in grade; new headgear needs to make a massive difference.

races.paceDynamic: Northern Symphonie will take the early lead with her prominent style, likely joined or pressed by Ezmerellda who also shows early pace. With only one confirmed front runner and four hold-up horses, Northern Symphonie can dictate a steady rhythm without serious early pressure over this stamina-testing 2m4f trip. The lack of pace pressure early will set up a tactical finish where the prominent runners can maintain their advantage, while the hold-up quartet may struggle to make ground from off the pace in a small field. This race shape strongly favours the early pace horses who can control the tempo and kick clear.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Northern Symphonie gets an easy lead and stays on strongly
scenarios.body: She faces minimal early pressure and can dictate ideal fractions, while the hold-up horses struggle to close the gap in a slowly-run race. Her cheekpieces debut and fence switch could unlock improvement at the perfect moment.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Tell Late
scenarios.trigger: If Regal Renaissance finds her best form and times her challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: The favourite's superior class rating and recent Stratford second suggests she has more in hand than these rivals. Sam Twiston-Davies can use her hold-up style to good effect if the early pace is strong enough.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Skelton Stable Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Claim Du Brizais produces his Warwick third form and mistakes are minimized
scenarios.body: Harry Skelton's booking for the in-form Dan Skelton yard suggests confidence, and his previous chase form shows more potential than recent efforts indicate. The strong stable form gives this combination live chances.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If both early leaders fold completely and the race becomes a sprint
scenarios.body: Northern Symphonie and Ezmerellda both show questionable stamina for this trip, potentially leaving the door open for a closer. This would require a dramatic pace collapse that seems unlikely given the lack of early speed.

watchPoints.text: Northern Symphonie's early position - if she gets loose on the lead unchallenged, she becomes very dangerous in this weak pace scenario
Regal Renaissance's jumping - needs to be slick at the obstacles to make up ground from her hold-up position against the early pace
Claim Du Brizais at the start - any market confidence for the Skelton runner would be significant given trainer's current form
The pace through halfway - if both Northern Symphonie and Ezmerellda are allowed to crawl, the hold-up horses face an impossible task
Northern Air's early positioning - new stable debut means tactical approach uncertain, could be key to her chances

races.name: Heartsease Farm Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Snapius
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with strong recent form who should relish the steady pace and prove hard to peg back

runners_data.name: Steady The Ship
runners_data.note: Lone pace-setter returning from 44 days off but faces stamina questions after three successive chase pull-ups
runners_data.comment: Pulled up in three successive chases before tailed off back over hurdles; no appeal
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled up in three successive chases before finishing tailed off back over hurdles; no appeal.

runners_data.name: Midnight View
runners_data.note: Natural hold-up performer with solid handicap form who benefits from patient Stan Sheppard riding tactics

runners_data.name: Jafimgoso
runners_data.note: Hold-up type stepping up to longer trip for first time since disappointing 66-1 effort in maiden over course and distance
runners_data.comment: His handicaps have been at 2m and when he tried this trip before he was 66-1 in a maiden
runners_data.spotlight: Good-ground bumper winner; disappointing over hurdles, though his handicaps have been at 2m and when he tried this trip once before he was 66-1 in a maiden; could easily be a factor.

runners_data.name: Izzy's Grey
runners_data.note: Long-term maiden whose best efforts come on good ground but needs everything to fall right from rear
runners_data.comment: Has the odd bit of form, as when beaten 6.5l at Chepstow last time
runners_data.spotlight: 14-race maiden over hurdles but he has the odd bit of form, as when beaten 6.5l at Chepstow last time (2m3f, good to soft); previous best efforts were on good ground; can run well.

runners_data.name: Ramaah
runners_data.note: Prominent racer attempting longer trip for first time with poor hurdles record but represents inform yard
runners_data.comment: 0-13 over hurdles and hasn't been shaping as though he's about to put that right
runners_data.spotlight: AW winner over 1m5f; 0-13 over hurdles and hasn't been shaping as though he's about to put that right; attempts a longer trip this afternoon; 2lb out of the weights.

runners_data.name: Jour d'Orage

races.paceDynamic: Steady The Ship is the lone confirmed front runner in this eight-runner handicap hurdle, giving him a soft lead at what should be a sustainable gallop over this staying trip. With most rivals (Snapius, Midnight View, Jafimgoso, Izzy's Grey, Jour d'Orage, Man Of Riddles) holding up and only Ramaah racing prominently, there's minimal early pace pressure. The lack of speed will create a tactical affair with a sprint finish, but the extended trip means stamina becomes crucial in the final half-mile. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses with proven stamina who can quicken off the modest gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady throughout and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows patient riders to position perfectly before unleashing late kicks. Proven stayers with turn of foot benefit most from the tactical nature and sustained finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Steady The Ship gets too easy a lead and maintains stamina
scenarios.body: The 10-year-old gets first run on his rivals and holds on grimly as the hold-up horses make their moves too late. His recent chase failures mask his hurdles ability over this longer trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Racer Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If Ramaah can improve for the step up in trip
scenarios.body: The 5-year-old sits handy behind Steady The Ship and has first chance to respond when the pace quickens. His flat speed helps him bridge the gap between early leader and hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Steady The Ship goes too slow even for staying types
scenarios.body: The race becomes a crawl that negates stamina advantages and turns into a pure sprint where any horse can win. The tactical nature becomes so extreme that positioning trumps ability.

watchPoints.text: Watch Steady The Ship's stamina reserves in final half-mile after recent chase failures and 44-day layoff
Monitor how aggressively the hold-up horses are positioned turning for home given the likely slow pace
Check if Jafimgoso handles the step up to 2m5½f better than his previous disappointing attempt over course and distance
Observe whether Snapius and Midnight View get clear runs in what could become a crowded finish
Note if Ramaah shows any improvement for the longer trip given his poor hurdles record to date
